children.title: Right to Information and Obligations of Public Authorities
Request for obtaining information
children.text: A person who desires to obtain any information under this Act shall make a request in writing or through electronic means.

children.title: Disposal of request
children.text: The Central Public Information Officer or State Public Information Officer shall dispose of the request within thirty days.

children.title: Exemption from disclosure of information
children.text: There shall be no obligation to give any citizen information which would prejudicially affect the sovereignty and integrity of India.
